evidence: Visual observations of the eight website slideshow assets. Tap flows are proposed from documentation, not live app tests.

screens.visual_observation: Single-habit contribution grids and a compact multi-habit widget.
screens.interaction_to_build: Widget selection, completion action and midnight refresh.
screens.implementation_note: WidgetKit plus App Intents and shared app storage.

screens.visual_observation: Dense rows: colored leading icon, title and recent-day squares.
screens.interaction_to_build: Tap today or a recent date; open detail separately.
screens.implementation_note: Accessible targets around small squares; consistent day-key calculations.

screens.visual_observation: Large grid, goal/streak chips and a navigable monthly calendar.
screens.interaction_to_build: Edit past days, open day notes and inspect the habit.
screens.implementation_note: One history model should feed calendar and heatmap.

screens.visual_observation: Icon area, name/description fields and a palette.
screens.interaction_to_build: Select identity; configure build/quit, tracking and goals.
screens.implementation_note: Keep creation short and optional controls progressive.

screens.visual_observation: Year navigation, metric cards and a monthly completions chart.
Stacked cards with full grids and colored schedule chips.
screens.interaction_to_build: Quick check-in, detail navigation and context actions.
screens.implementation_note: Virtualize/cache grids when many habits are present.

screens.visual_observation: Image preview, light/dark toggle, palette and share button.
screens.interaction_to_build: Configure image appearance and open system sharing.
screens.implementation_note: Generate original artwork using an independent app identity.

screens.visual_observation: Three-column collection of mini monthly calendars.
screens.interaction_to_build: Browse months and check progress across many habits.
screens.implementation_note: Handle narrow screens, Dynamic Type and large habit collections.
